title: Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.16005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. translated_title: 检索引导的双重融合与相似性感知对比用于分子-文本对齐
translated_abstract: 本文研究了分子-文本对齐问题，旨在将分子及其文本描述投影到联合潜在空间，以支持下游任务，如分子搜索和分子性质预测。以往方法通常结合图结构挖掘与对比学习来增强联合表示学习。然而，它们通常忽视了子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，导致在下游任务上性能次优。为此，我们提出了一种名为检索引导的双重融合与相似性感知对比（RISEN）的新方法，用于分子-文本对齐。RISEN的核心思想是为每个子结构构建一个潜在孪生分子，通过跨模态检索进行语义增强。具体而言，对于每个子结构查询，我们检索相关的文本描述，并采样多个共享相似描述的分子。
tldr: 提出了一种检索引导的双重融合与相似性感知对比方法，通过为每个子结构构建潜在孪生分子并利用跨模态检索增强语义关系，从而提升分子-文本对齐性能。
en_tdlr: Proposed a retrieval-guided twin fusion with similarity-aware contrast method that enhances molecule-text alignment by constructing latent twin molecules for substructures and leveraging cross-modal retrieval to improve semantic relationships.
